scenes.text: Imagine standing in a breathtakingly beautiful corner of Yellowstone National Park where you could theoretically commit a major crime and legally get away with it completely free.
This mysterious fifty-square-mile strip of land is famously known as the Zone of Death, all because of a bizarre loophole in the United States Constitution regarding local jury selection.

Because the law state-mandates that a jury must be formed from residents living in both the state and federal district of the crime, and absolutely nobody lives in this specific Idaho sector, a trial is constitutionally impossible.

Although the federal government is fully aware of this terrifying legal blindspot, they have failed to fix it, so would you ever dare to camp in this lawless territory, and will you follow for more dark secrets?
